notes.title: Overcome Update v1.02 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.02
--------
Changed a little bit of the level layout to fix pacing issues.
Fixed bug where there was a delay in input during an NPC encounter in snow level.
--------

notes.title: Overcome Update v1.01 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
A day one patch has been dispatched to fix certain bugs and visual glitches.


v1.01
---------------------------------------
Fixed a bug where the shooter in the last level glitched out on a wall.
Fixed collision boxes in lasers in the last level.
Fixed jumper in final boss fight not jumping until you hit the ground it is on.
Fixed restarting the game after you beat it disabled the player and broke the sprite.
Fixed vertical lasers' particles having incorrect rotation.
Fixed jumper having the wrong particle colour in boss fight.
----------------------------------------

notes.title: Overcome launches today!
notes.content:
Hello!

Overcome has been been a deeply personal journey to me. It has been a creative outlet for me over the last six months, and I'm extremely excited to share it with the world.

I hope you have a good time playing the game!

Kabir,
Developer
